note: Clicking your OWN avatar in a room on the live Habbo hotel. Four requests leave in one millisecond and the hotel answers two of them. Header ids are AIR-1.0.31's (all six resolve in com/sulake/habbo/communication/_SafeCls_2127.as) and are NOT the emulator target build's, so only the order, the membership and the field values are evidence here. THREE THINGS IT SETTLES. (1) ClickCharacter and LookTo get NO answer: LookTo carries the clicker's own tile (4,4), the avatar is already facing it and the hotel emits nothing -- the same no-op this emulator takes when dx and dy are both zero. (2) HabboUserBadges really is four fields per badge and not two: slot, code, ownerCount, badgeRarityId, which is what the WIN63 parser reads and what the field_count conflict cf_7fce59e4b2 had listed as official:unknown. (3) ownerCount comes back as exactly 1000 on both badges, and 1000 is the sentinel the client's own guard rejects -- shouldShowOwnerCount is `count > 0 && count < 1000` -- so Habbo caps the number at 1000 to hide the line rather than sending a true count. An emulator sending 0 there renders identically. The account has 2 equipped badges, no relationship decorators and no HC. CAVEAT ON PAIRING: the four requests go out back to back before either answer arrives, so the observations derived from this file hang both answers off GetRelationshipStatusInfo, the last request sent. HabboUserBadges answers GetSelectedBadges and RelationshipStatusInfo answers GetRelationshipStatusInfo; the pairing in the observations is an artefact of the file, not of Habbo.
